title: NO FREE STRONGHOLD PAY AFTER THE TAKEOVER
why: His ruling: the remaining player picks up the raid when the host is gone. Player 2 window rebuilds each stronghold from the host world word with no defenders of its own (the defenders are host bodies). After the host was gone this window ran the host stronghold code, and an open stronghold with no defenders counted as cleared at once: STRONGHOLD CLEARED and +1,000 for nothing (career chips become real credits at the settle). Proven in a staged pair: the host breaches a stronghold with its defenders alive, the word goes to player 2, the host goes out, and one stronghold tick paid 1,000. Now a stronghold pays its clear only when this window held defenders for it and they are all dead. A stronghold still closed at the takeover works as before: breaching it calls the defenders here and killing them pays. Side effect: an open stronghold rebuilt from the word stays open and pinned on the maps, never marked cleared.
now: When your partner leaves, a stronghold they had breached no longer pays out STRONGHOLD CLEARED for nothing.

edits.replacement: if(!alive&&s.def.length+s.def2.length>0){ s.clear=1; flowChip(SH.chip,'STRONGHOLD CLEARED','STRONGHOLD'); }   // v16.xx (cloud-coop-takeover-no-free-stronghold), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: a site rebuilt from the host word has no defenders here, so after the takeover it is not a free clear
